title: Campus
subtitle: 「校園／大學校園範圍」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「校園／大學校園範圍」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 campus 最直接、最自然的近義表達之一。
words.example: Smoking is prohibited on the university grounds.
words.exampleZh: 大學校園範圍內禁止吸煙。

exercises.original: Smoking is prohibited anywhere on campus.
exercises.zh: 整個大學校園範圍內禁止吸煙。
exercises.upgrade: Smoking is prohibited anywhere on the university grounds.

options.explanation: 表示大學整體土地和校園範圍，和 campus 高度接近。
指學院或教職員，不是物理範圍。
只是校園中的一個庭院。

exercises.original: Visitors are free to walk around the campus during the day.
exercises.zh: 訪客日間可自由在大學校園內走動。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors are free to walk around the university grounds during the day.

options.explanation: 戶外行走和整體校園範圍非常符合 grounds。

exercises.original: Security patrols the campus throughout the night.
exercises.zh: 保安整晚巡邏大學校園。
exercises.upgrade: Security patrols the university grounds throughout the night.

options.explanation: 巡邏的是整個校園物理範圍。

words.note: 和 university grounds 相同邏輯，但用於 college。
words.example: Visitors are welcome to walk around the college grounds.
words.exampleZh: 歡迎訪客在學院校園內四處參觀。

exercises.original: The college campus includes several historic gardens.
exercises.zh: 學院校園包括幾個歷史花園。
exercises.upgrade: The college grounds include several historic gardens.

options.explanation: 花園、草地和戶外空間很適合用 grounds。

exercises.original: Students gathered across the campus for the festival.
exercises.zh: 學生在學院校園各處參加節慶活動。
exercises.upgrade: Students gathered across the college grounds for the festival.

exercises.original: No vehicles are allowed on the campus after 10 p.m.
exercises.zh: 晚上十時後，車輛不得進入學院校園。
exercises.upgrade: No vehicles are allowed on the college grounds after 10 p.m.

options.explanation: 交通規則通常適用於校園土地範圍。

words.note: 強調大學所在的具體地點或某一個校區。
words.example: The university operates from two separate sites.
words.exampleZh: 這所大學在兩個不同校區運作。

exercises.original: The university has two campuses, one in the city centre and one outside town.
exercises.zh: 這所大學有兩個校區，一個在市中心，一個在城外。
exercises.upgrade: The university has two sites, one in the city centre and one outside town.

options.explanation: 多個 campus / locations 時，site 是非常自然的改寫。
學院，不一定位於不同校址。

exercises.original: The new engineering campus will open next year.
exercises.zh: 新的工程校區將於明年啟用。
exercises.upgrade: The new engineering university site will open next year.

options.explanation: 強調一個具體的新校址／校區。

exercises.original: Most science teaching takes place on the north campus.
exercises.zh: 大部分科學教學都在北校區進行。
exercises.upgrade: Most science teaching takes place on the north university site.

options.explanation: 表示大學的一個特定校址。
faculty 不是地點概念本身。

words.note: 和 university site 很接近，用於 college。
words.example: The new library will be built on the college site.
words.exampleZh: 新圖書館將建於學院校區內。

exercises.original: The college campus will expand onto neighbouring land.
exercises.zh: 學院校區將擴展至鄰近土地。
exercises.upgrade: The college site will expand onto neighbouring land.

options.explanation: site 很適合土地與發展規劃語境。

exercises.original: Construction work is taking place on the campus.
exercises.zh: 學院校區正在進行建築工程。
exercises.upgrade: Construction work is taking place on the college site.

options.explanation: construction + physical location 是 site 的典型語境。

exercises.original: The campus covers almost fifteen hectares.
exercises.zh: 學院校區佔地接近十五公頃。
exercises.upgrade: The college site covers almost fifteen hectares.

options.explanation: 面積／土地大小語境很自然。

words.meaning: 大學場所；大學校內範圍
words.note: 較正式地表示大學所使用、管理或佔用的建築與土地。
words.example: Alcohol may not be sold on university premises without permission.
words.exampleZh: 未經許可，不得在大學場所內售賣酒精飲品。

exercises.original: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on campus.
exercises.zh: 大學場所內任何地方都禁止吸煙。
exercises.upgrade: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on university premises.

options.explanation: 規章／禁止事項的正式行政語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Visitors must wear identification while on campus.
exercises.zh: 訪客在大學場所內必須佩戴識別證。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors must wear identification while on university premises.

options.explanation: 保安規則適用於機構場所。

exercises.original: Commercial filming requires permission anywhere on the campus.
exercises.zh: 在大學場所內進行商業拍攝必須取得許可。
exercises.upgrade: Commercial filming requires permission anywhere on university premises.

options.explanation: 許可／法律／管理語氣非常合適。

words.meaning: 學院場所；學院校內範圍
words.note: 表示學院所使用的整體場所。
words.example: The event must remain within the college premises.
words.exampleZh: 活動必須在學院範圍內進行。

exercises.original: The event must remain on campus at all times.
exercises.zh: 活動必須全程在學院場所內進行。
exercises.upgrade: The event must remain on college premises at all times.

exercises.original: Security cameras operate throughout the campus.
exercises.zh: 學院場所各處都有保安攝影機運作。
exercises.upgrade: Security cameras operate throughout the college premises.

options.explanation: 保安與場所管理很適合 premises。

exercises.original: Food deliveries are restricted on campus after midnight.
exercises.zh: 午夜後，學院場所限制外賣送餐。
exercises.upgrade: Food deliveries are restricted on college premises after midnight.

words.meaning: 大學校產；大學土地及建築範圍
words.note: 在英式大學行政／設施管理語境中很常見，指大學所擁有或管理的土地、建築與基礎設施。
words.example: The university is investing heavily in its estate.
words.exampleZh: 大學正大力投資改善校產。

exercises.original: The university plans to modernize buildings across the campus.
exercises.zh: 大學計劃現代化整個校產範圍內的建築。
exercises.upgrade: The university plans to modernize buildings across the university estate.

options.explanation: 設施、建築、土地資產管理的典型用法。

exercises.original: Energy use across the campus has fallen by ten percent.
exercises.zh: 整個大學校產的能源使用量下降了百分之十。
exercises.upgrade: Energy use across the university estate has fallen by ten percent.

options.explanation: 能源、建築與設施管理很適合 estate。

exercises.original: The facilities team manages maintenance across the campus.
exercises.zh: 設施團隊負責整個大學校產的維修管理。
exercises.upgrade: The facilities team manages maintenance across the university estate.

options.explanation: facilities management 和 estate 是非常自然的搭配。

words.meaning: 大學建築群；大學綜合設施區
words.note: 表示由多棟建築和設施構成的整體校園建築群。
words.example: The new research centre forms part of the university complex.
words.exampleZh: 新的研究中心是大學建築群的一部分。

exercises.original: The campus contains laboratories, libraries, residences, and sports facilities.
exercises.zh: 大學建築群包括實驗室、圖書館、宿舍和體育設施。
exercises.upgrade: The university complex contains laboratories, libraries, residences, and sports facilities.

options.explanation: 多棟建築和設施形成的整體建築群。

exercises.original: A pedestrian bridge connects the two halves of the campus.
exercises.zh: 一條行人天橋連接大學建築群的兩部分。
exercises.upgrade: A pedestrian bridge connects the two halves of the university complex.

options.explanation: 強調物理建築群和設施連接。

exercises.original: The campus was designed as a single integrated group of buildings.
exercises.zh: 這個校園被設計成一體化的大學建築群。
exercises.upgrade: The campus was designed as a single integrated university complex.

options.explanation: group of buildings 是直接線索。

words.meaning: 學術區；校園學術核心區
words.note: 指集中設有大學建築、教學設施或研究機構的一片區域。
words.example: Several libraries are located within the academic precinct.
words.exampleZh: 幾間圖書館都位於學術區內。

exercises.original: Several libraries and research institutes are clustered on the campus.
exercises.zh: 數間圖書館和研究機構集中在學術區內。
exercises.upgrade: Several libraries and research institutes are clustered within the academic precinct.

options.explanation: 多個學術設施集中在一片區域，最自然。

exercises.original: The city's main campus is integrated into the downtown area.
exercises.zh: 這座城市的主要學術區融入市中心。
exercises.upgrade: The city's main academic precinct is integrated into the downtown area.

options.explanation: 城市型大學與周邊街區融合時很自然。

exercises.original: New pedestrian routes will connect the campus with nearby cultural institutions.
exercises.zh: 新的行人路線將把學術區和附近文化機構連接起來。
exercises.upgrade: New pedestrian routes will connect the academic precinct with nearby cultural institutions.

options.explanation: 空間規劃語境非常自然。

words.note: 指大學建築及其周邊形成的一個集中區域。
words.example: Traffic is restricted within the university precinct.
words.exampleZh: 大學校園區域內限制車輛通行。

exercises.original: Traffic is restricted within the campus.
exercises.zh: 大學校園區域內限制車輛通行。
exercises.upgrade: Traffic is restricted within the university precinct.

options.explanation: 表示一個劃定的校園區域。

exercises.original: Most cafés around the campus cater to students.
exercises.zh: 大學區附近的大部分咖啡店主要服務學生。
exercises.upgrade: Most cafés around the university precinct cater to students.

options.explanation: 可指大學建築集中形成的區域。

exercises.original: Cycling routes run through the campus and into the city centre.
exercises.zh: 單車路線穿過大學校園區並延伸至市中心。
exercises.upgrade: Cycling routes run through the university precinct and into the city centre.

options.explanation: 交通／空間規劃語境自然。

words.note: 當 campus 泛指學校而不一定是大學時，可用 school grounds。
words.example: Students must remain on the school grounds during lunchtime.
words.exampleZh: 學生午飯時間必須留在校園範圍內。

exercises.original: Students must remain on campus during lunchtime.
exercises.zh: 學生午飯時間必須留在校園範圍內。
exercises.upgrade: Students must remain on the school grounds during lunchtime.

options.explanation: 中小學校園範圍的自然說法。

exercises.original: The campus includes a playground, sports field, and garden.
exercises.zh: 校園包括遊樂場、運動場和花園。
exercises.upgrade: The school grounds include a playground, sports field, and garden.

options.explanation: 戶外學校設施是典型 grounds 語境。

exercises.original: Parents are not allowed to park on campus before dismissal time.
exercises.zh: 放學前家長不得在校園範圍內泊車。
exercises.upgrade: Parents are not allowed to park on the school grounds before dismissal time.

options.explanation: 學校交通與泊車規則最自然。

words.note: 較正式、概括地表示某教育機構或大型機構的土地範圍。
words.example: Parking is restricted on the institutional grounds.

exercises.original: Parking is restricted throughout the campus.
exercises.zh: 整個院校範圍內限制泊車。
exercises.upgrade: Parking is restricted throughout the institutional grounds.

options.explanation: 正式概括某機構的土地範圍。

exercises.original: The campus is closed to the public after midnight.
exercises.zh: 院校範圍午夜後不對公眾開放。
exercises.upgrade: The institutional grounds are closed to the public after midnight.

options.explanation: 正式的管理／保安語境可用。

exercises.original: The campus contains protected trees and historic buildings.
exercises.zh: 院校範圍內有受保護樹木和歷史建築。
exercises.upgrade: The institutional grounds contain protected trees and historic buildings.

options.explanation: 土地＋建築的正式概括很自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一棟大學建築不等於校園 campus 通常包含多棟建築、道路、戶外空間及設施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lecture is in the science building. The science building is on campus.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學院／教職員群體不等於校園 faculty 可以指學院，也可以指教職員。 它不是物理校園範圍。
學系不等於校園 department 是學術／行政單位，不是所在地。
四方庭院只是校園的一部分 quad 是校園中的庭院或四方空間，不等於整個 campus。
宿舍只是校園設施之一 宿舍可能在 campus 上，但不能代表整個 campus。
課室不等於校園 classroom 是單一教學空間。
校園生活不等於校園地點 campus life 指學生在校園中的社交、學習和生活經驗。
範圍焦點不同 - campus = 整體校園概念 - grounds = 土地與戶外範圍 - premises = 機構所使用的場所，較正式 - site = 所在地／校址
